headline: Expedia Group (NASDAQ:EXPE) Looks Like a Decent Value Stock, Not a Value Trap
summary: Expedia Group shows decent value: low P/E vs industry, strong profitability and growth, but moderate balance sheet risks. A compelling value-play screen candidate.
